name: bare-ipc

exports.name: IPC
signatures:
interface IPC {
  readonly incoming: Pipe
  readonly outgoing: Pipe
  ref(): this
  unref(): this
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
  _read(size: number): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  push(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  unshift(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  read(): unknown | null
  resume(): this
  pause(): this
  pipe<S extends Writable>(dest: S, cb?: StreamCallback): S
  setEncoding(encoding: BufferEncoding): void
  _write(data: unknown, encoding: StreamEncoding, cb: StreamCallback): void
  _writev(batch: { chunk: unknown; encoding: StreamEncoding }[], cb: StreamCallback): void
  _final(cb: StreamCallback): void
  write(data: unknown, encoding?: BufferEncoding, cb?: StreamCallback): boolean
  end(cb?: StreamCallback): this
  cork(): void
  uncork(): void
}

members.name: IPC
members.description: Returns a duplex stream using the provided `port`. See `bare-stream`'s `Duplex` (<https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-stream>) for the duplex stream API.

params.name: port
params.description: The port to open the stream over, as returned by `IPC.open()`.

members.name: incoming
members.description: The underlying `bare-pipe` `Pipe` used for reading. Read-only.

members.name: IPC.open
members.description: Returns a pair of connected `IPCPort`s for constructing the IPC duplex stream based on `bare-pipe`. Each port is transferable and can be sent to another thread or process before being connected.

returns.description: A pair of connected ports, one for each end of the IPC channel.

members.name: outgoing
members.description: The underlying `bare-pipe` `Pipe` used for writing. Read-only.

members.name: ref
members.description: Increase the reference count for the IPC to keep the event loop alive.

members.name: unref
members.description: Decrease the reference count for the IPC to allow the event loop to exit.

exports.name: IPCPort

members.name: IPCPort
members.description: Constructs a port from a pair of file handles, `incoming` and `outgoing`.

params.name: incoming
params.description: The file handle used for reading.

params.name: outgoing
params.description: The file handle used for writing.

returns.description: An `IPC` duplex stream connected to the port.

members.name: detached
members.description: A boolean for whether the `port` is detached. A port becomes detached once it is connected or transferred, and a detached port cannot be transferred again.

members.name: incoming
members.description: The file handle used for reading. Read-only.

members.name: outgoing
members.description: The file handle used for writing. Read-only.

members.name: IPCError.ALREADY_CONNECTED
members.description: Create the error thrown when transferring a port that has already been connected or transferred.
